actions_or_findings.title: 1. Enable the DevTools service port
actions_or_findings.path: WeChat DevTools → 设置 → 安全设置 → 服务端口
actions_or_findings.trigger: The IDE service port is currently off, so Cursor cannot execute the DevTools CLI workflow.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Operator must enable the service port and leave DevTools running. This is the single required human gate; do not request Full Access or sandbox bypass.

actions_or_findings.title: 2. Reconfirm the immutable preflight baseline
actions_or_findings.trigger: Run after the service port is enabled and before opening the project.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Run `git rev-parse HEAD`, `git status --short`, `Get-FileHash miniprogram\project.config.json -Algorithm SHA256`, and GET-only probes of `/healthz` and `/readyz`. Expect HEAD `c44c051d6d52a34dae13c61dd17afb7589f61473`, project-config hash `3FBE70AE8438D137498E55BDD289357473715231E4C96DABA7DEF7601741352D`, and HTTP 200/200. Preserve all existing dirty/untracked files.

actions_or_findings.title: 3. Verify DevTools authentication through CLI
actions_or_findings.trigger: The service port has been enabled.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Run `& 'D:\微信web开发者工具\cli.bat' islogin --project 'D:\property-ai\miniprogram' --lang zh` and save its output. Continue only if it confirms a logged-in IDE; if logged out, stop and request the QR-scan action rather than expanding scope.

actions_or_findings.title: 4. Open and compile the existing mini program
actions_or_findings.rationale: Run `& 'D:\微信web开发者工具\cli.bat' open --project 'D:\property-ai\miniprogram' --lang zh`. Expected evidence is the existing project opening with AppID `wxcfa5fd7dc03cac56`, a successful compile, and no source/config edits.

actions_or_findings.title: 5. Show a clean local-preview login page
actions_or_findings.rationale: In the DevTools console run `wx.removeStorageSync('access_token'); wx.reLaunch({url:'/pages/login/login'})`. Confirm the page shows API `http://127.0.0.1:8082/api/v1` and the `以住户登录` button. Capture the login-page screenshot.

actions_or_findings.title: 6. Exercise only the resident authentication chain
actions_or_findings.trigger: The local-preview login page is visible.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Clear the DevTools Network panel, tap `以住户登录` once, and expect `POST /api/v1/auth/dev/token` with seed key `__DEV_RESIDENT__` returning 200, followed by at least one `GET /api/v1/me` returning 200. Capture the request list/statuses without recording the access-token response or Authorization header.

actions_or_findings.title: 7. Verify the home is driven by live /me data
actions_or_findings.rationale: Confirm navigation to home, displayed name `__DEV_RESIDENT__`, role containing `RESIDENT`, and the resident menu rendered because `/me.permissions` contains `work_order:create`. Do not enter house binding, work-order, staff, or supervisor flows. Capture `/me` evidence and the resident-home screenshot.

actions_or_findings.title: 8. Record the result and enforce the no-change guard
actions_or_findings.trigger: Visual and network assertions are complete, or an in-scope request fails.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Write a token-free result JSON containing HEAD, timestamps, config hash, compile result, request method/path/status, and the minimal `/me` projection. Then rerun `git status --short` and the project-config hash. Expect no tracked mini-program change except the pre-existing `project.config.json`, whose hash must remain unchanged. If DevTools changes it, do not stage, revert, or overwrite it; record the delta and stop.
